answer: Require every agent to lock 50 POA for 90 days before earning, with identity anchored in a basalt-hard registry checking one device fingerprint and one payment trail per account. A farm faces a rising tide of cost: 1,000 fakes need 50,000 POA locked plus distinct hardware. If 20 percent of attestations are flagged inconsistent within 48 hours, an audit freezes rewards; confirmed fakes lose 100 percent of stake, like an ember burning out its own fuel. One farm of 400 clones was caught sharing one IP block and attesting in identical 30-second intervals.
